# Grasp: Workout Planner

> Grasp is a free workout planner and logger for Android and iPhone. It plans each workout around your goal, your schedule and the equipment you have, and works out your weights from what you logged last time. It is free, with no ads, no subscription and no paid tier, and it works offline after the first sign-up. It is available in 15 languages. An Android version is coming soon.

Also listed on the App Store as "Grasp: Workout Planner & Log". Several unrelated apps are called Grasp; this one is the workout planner.

## Facts

- Price: free. No ads, no subscription, no paid tier, nothing to unlock.
- Platform: Android (Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.graspapp.mobile) and iPhone (App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6804474068).
- Offline: planning and weight suggestions run on the phone. Only the first sign-up needs internet; the account backs up training so it survives a lost phone.
- Languages: English, Arabic, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Turkish, Polish, Russian, Hindi, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Indonesian, Portuguese. Screens, exercise names and step-by-step instructions are translated.
- Exercises: 600+, most of them animated, with the muscles they work.
- Equipment: you tick what you have (over 50 kinds, plus bodyweight) and it only plans exercises you can do. Saved setups for each place (home, gym, hotel), switched in one tap.
- Weights: from your own logs. Reach the top of your rep range on every set and the weight goes up; miss it twice and it comes down. Warm-up sets are worked out from the working weight. Any weight can be changed in one tap.
- Also: rest timer, interval timer with presets, a body map of what you trained recently, weekly set targets per muscle group, calendar log, export as a spreadsheet or full backup, share cards.
- Not AI: planning uses simple rules on the device, not a language model.
- Privacy: no advertising identifiers, analytics or usage tracking; does not ask for location, contacts or microphone.
- Not medical advice.
